The following events took place in '''3985 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Coruscant Financial Exchange]] [[Coruscant Financial Exchange Establishment Act|Establishment act]] speeds the restoration of the devastated [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by allowing corporations to invest in the government's infrastructure in return for guaranteeing safe passage through increasingly treacherous hyperspace routes.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
